page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 32 vCPUs, operating at 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It has no local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps. The virtualization is managed via KVM.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core CPU performance is weak, falling into the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, with stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU scores all placing in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth is also average, though the Passmark memory score is weak. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput all perform within the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced resource density of 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM without the added cost of local storage or GPU hardware. It is suited for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded processing but do not require high single-core clock speeds or local NVMe storage. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded data processing, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
